description: Unit test class for the DeletePolicy command, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation.

classes.name: DeletePolicyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the DeletePolicy command implementation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DeletePolicy instances are immutable and that PolicyId objects are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations of DeletePolicy.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeletePolicy with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeletePolicy with a null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeletePolicy with an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that DeletePolicy's toJson method produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a DeletePolicy instance can be created from a valid JSON string and it has the expected entityId.
